mapper.select:
SELECT seq , promoter_name , display_order , file_name , original_file_name , reg_dt , mod_dt FROM TB_PROMOTER
ORDER BY display_order ASC, reg_dt DESC, seq DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{amount}
SELECT seq , promoter_name , display_order , file_name , original_file_name , reg_dt , mod_dt FROM TB_PROMOTER WHERE seq = #{seq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PROMOTER ( promoter_name, display_order, file_name, original_file_name, reg_dt, mod_dt ) VALUES ( #{promoterName}, #{displayOrder}, #{fileName}, #{originalFileName}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update:
UPDATE TB_PROMOTER
promoter_name = #{promoterName}, display_order = #{displayOrder},
file_name = #{fileName}, original_file_name = #{originalFileName},
WHERE seq = #{seq}

UPDATE TB_PROMOTER t JOIN ( SELECT p.seq, (@rownum := @rownum + 1) * 10 AS new_order FROM TB_PROMOTER p CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rownum := 0) AS dummy ORDER BY p.display_order ASC, p.reg_dt DESC, p.seq DESC ) r ON t.seq = r.seq SET t.display_order = r.new_order
